coastal.title: Langford tries new tool for mitigating wildfires: a herd of goats
coastal.description: A herd of 13 goats spent Friday clambering to munch on a thicket of blackberry bushes and brambles near the Starlight Stadium in Langford – part of a pilot program to prune the city's flammable underbrush and raise awareness of fire safety tools.

kamloops.title: Preschool fire safety lessons put to the test during Summerland evacuation
kamloops.description: As Learning Cove Preschool prepares to welcome children back, staff say fire safety lessons taught in the classroom helped prepare students

kamloops.title: More Summerland residents allowed home as Bald Range fire grows to 24,000 hectares
kamloops.description: The Regional District of Okanagan-Similkameen has downgraded an evacuation order to an alert for nearly the entire community except the Garnet Valley area.

kamloops.title: OPP renew call for help after remains of B.C. woman found in Ontario
kamloops.description: Ontario Provincial Police are renewing calls for help in solving a 21-year-old case involving the remains of a British Columbia woman found in the province.

kamloops.title: Following fire, Summerland orchards race to save fruit from spoilage
kamloops.description: While Deep Brar’s property is physically undamaged by the flames, his business, Brarstar Orchards, has still incurred a significant cost — much of his fruit was left to rot on the trees during the evacuation.
